precursors.name: Li(thd)
precursors.evidence: Five different lithium containing compounds, all representing different chemical systems, were studied in order to deposit lithium containing films by atomic layer deposition ALD. The studied compounds were a lithium b-diketonate Li(thd) (thd ¼ 2,2,6,6-tetramethyl-3,5-heptanedionate), a lithium alkoxide LiO tBu (OtBu ¼ tert-butoxide), a lithium cyclopentadienyl LiCp (Cp ¼ cyclopentadienyl), a lithium alkyl n-butyllithium, and a lithium amide lithium dicyclohexylamide.

evidence: Five different lithium containing compounds, all representing different chemical systems, were studied in order to deposit lithium containing films by atomic layer deposition ALD. The studied compounds were a lithium b-diketonate Li(thd) (thd ¼ 2,2,6,6-tetramethyl-3,5-heptanedionate), a lithium alkoxide LiO tBu (OtBu ¼ tert-butoxide), a lithium cyclopentadienyl LiCp (Cp ¼ cyclopentadienyl), a lithium alkyl n-butyllithium, and a lithium amide lithium dicyclohexylamide. Films containing lithium carbonate (Li 2CO3) were obtained from alternate pulsing of Li(thd) and ozone in a temperature range of 185–300 /C14 C. Lithium containing films were also obtained from LiCp and water and from LiO tBu and water. The reactor pressure was ca. 3m bar and a N2 flow (99.9995%) of 300 cm 3 min/C0 1 was used as a carrier gas.
